purpose: An independently completed child copies an owning array with an embedded global reference into a direct parent yield-from result. After real null-key unpack rejection and parent close, rebinding the shared cell must update that retained array rather than pin its original payload object.
source:
<?php
class ReviewDetachedCellCache27 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewDetachedCellOld27 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
class ReviewDetachedCellNew27 { function __destruct() { echo "CNEW|"; } }
function reviewDetachedCellChild27() { global $slot; echo "C|"; yield new ReviewDetachedCellCache27(); echo "L|"; $slot = new ReviewDetachedCellOld27(); return [&$slot]; }
function reviewDetachedCellParent27() { try { echo "G|"; $result = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-TAIL|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewDetachedCellTarget27($value) { echo "BAD-CALLEE|"; }
$child = reviewDetachedCellChild27(); $parent = reviewDetachedCellParent27(); echo "P|"; $parent->rewind(); $child->next();
echo "V|", $parent->current() instanceof ReviewDetachedCellCache27 ? "HELD|" : "BAD|", "K|", $parent->key() === null ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($child); echo "M|";
try { reviewDetachedCellTarget27(...$parent); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; }
catch (Error $caught) { echo "T|", $caught->getLine(), "|", $caught->getTrace() === [] ? "NOFRAME|" : "FRAME|"; }
unset($parent); echo "CLOSED|";
$slot = new ReviewDetachedCellNew27(); echo "WRITE|"; unset($slot); echo "UNSET|";
unset($caught); echo "E";

purpose: A temporary sole direct parent has a distinct cached object and owning copied return. Null-key unpack cleanup may run the cache destructor before caller catch while the copied return has its own lifetime; capture replacement/previous identities and order without a stdout forecast.
source:
<?php
class ReviewDetachedTemporaryCache27 { function __destruct() { echo "D|"; throw new Exception("detached-cache27"); } }
class ReviewDetachedTemporaryReturn27 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
function reviewDetachedTemporaryChild27() { echo "C|"; yield new ReviewDetachedTemporaryCache27(); echo "L|"; return new ReviewDetachedTemporaryReturn27(); }
function reviewDetachedTemporaryParent27() { try { echo "G|"; $result = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-TAIL|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewDetachedTemporaryTake27() { $selected = $GLOBALS["parent"]; unset($GLOBALS["parent"]); echo "TAKE|"; return $selected; }
function reviewDetachedTemporaryTarget27($value) { echo "BAD-CALLEE|"; }
$child = reviewDetachedTemporaryChild27(); $parent = reviewDetachedTemporaryParent27(); echo "P|"; $parent->rewind(); $child->next();
echo "V|", $parent->current() instanceof ReviewDetachedTemporaryCache27 ? "HELD|" : "BAD|", "K|", $parent->key() === null ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($child); echo "M|";
try { reviewDetachedTemporaryTarget27(...reviewDetachedTemporaryTake27()); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; }
catch (Throwable $caught) { echo "CALLER|", $caught instanceof Exception ? "REPLACED|" : "KEY|", $caught->getPrevious() instanceof Error ? "PREV|" : "NOPREV|"; if ($caught->getPrevious() instanceof Error) { echo "LINE|", $caught->getPrevious()->getLine(), "|"; } }
unset($caught); echo "E";
